disease_state.evidence: inferred: In order to probe the conformation of Clusterin in the lipoprotein complex, free and lipid-bound protein were subjected to limited proteolysis with chymotrypsin and the resultant fragments analyzed by LC/MS proteomics (Part 2 of the deposited data).

material_type.evidence: Free human WT-Clu or TL4 mutant (R227Q) or their respective Clu–DMPC lipoprotein complex preparations at 10 µM Clu content were incubated with a series of bovine chymotrypsin (Merck) concentrations (0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50 nM) in TBS buffer containing 1 mM CaCl2 for 30 min at 25 °C.
